original_test_intent: Inject one approved AMD GPU fatal uncorrectable record on the intended device/component, decode the new table6.3 record as Fatal/MCE with target-correlated raw fields, then perform preapproved containment and recovery without retry.
original_method: Resolve GFX-versus-SDMA and copied Correctable wording first; map device1 to UUID/BDF/OAM/socket; verify block2/type4 semantics and ras_enable; capture a device1 pre-decode cursor and persistent/OOB logging; inject once; correlate target, Fatal/MCE and raw register record; follow the approved reset/reboot recovery and prove GPU/host restoration.
manual_activity: The GPU RAS owner resolves the component and fatal semantics, approves device1/block2/type4 and the destructive containment/recovery plan, supervises the one event and judges the decoded record.

Stable device1-to-UUID/BDF/OAM/socket map and proof block2/type4 is the intended fatal stimulus

Dedicated SUT, idle jobs, serial/OOB recovery, reboot/boot-health and restoration contract

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform one explicitly mapped fatal injection on the approved IP, capture persistent/OOB evidence and a fresh device1 Fatal/MCE decode, then execute controlled recovery.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds component reconciliation, target-stable identity, pre-decode freshness, fatal containment and post-reboot multi-GPU/host health.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A Fatal JSON record does not prove the intended component was exercised when the source names both GFX and SDMA and baselines another device/block.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The fatal event may reset the device or host before `-C` can run; persistent firmware/BMC and OOB traces are therefore mandatory.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item and Criteria are fatal, but Procedure calls step3 Decode Correctable Error Record. Command/sample name GFX block2 while Script path names SDMA. Baseline queries device0 UMC block0 although injection/decode target device1 block2; relevance is unexplained.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row119 Wistron-GPU RAS-00020-V003: confirm Fatal rather than the copied Correctable step label; decide GFX block2 as command/sample show versus SDMA as Script path names; prove type4 and explicit UUID/BDF/device1 target; explain or replace device0 UMC baseline; approve table6.3 Fatal/MCE fields, dynamic identity/freshness, containment/reset and persistent OOB evidence, no-retry recovery, boot/GPU health and restoration.

review_improvement: Finds the component and cross-device baseline conflicts in addition to the known severity wording defect, and adds fatal-event evidence survivability and recovery gates.
independent_technical_reasoning: A fatal record can end in-band access, so the test cannot rely solely on running the decoder afterward. More importantly, a GFX type4 command and an SDMA-named Script represent different component coverage until proven equivalent. Device1 must be mapped stably and its own preexisting records tracked; a device0 UMC query cannot establish freshness.
